trailhead.label: Lower lake car park past Scichizza, Fusine in Valromana, the board’s start

cautions: Boardwalks and roots along the lakeshore are slippery when wet.
Busy in summer and at weekends: keep your dog close on the narrow shore paths.
A protected Natura 2000 site: stay on the marked paths in the Scichizza bog.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
